note: After the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), itself adapted from the original description of Bose 1984; the alate, soldier and pseudoworker are all described and measured, and the type specimens were examined. Type locality Mangalore, Karnataka, India; nesting in dead mango twigs.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule red-brown; clypeus, labrum and antennae golden brown; mandible tips dark red-brown, posterior part lighter; thorax and body dark golden brown; legs pale yellow; wings brown and semi-transparent. Head and body rather densely hairy, legs sparsely hairy. Body length (with wings) 14.40—16.60, (without wings) 7.60—9.40 mm. Head capsule subquadrate and oval, width slightly greater than length to mandible base (length 1.45—1.65, width including compound eyes 1.60—1.70 mm); sides nearly parallel, posterolateral corners rounded; Y suture distinct. Compound eyes large, oval, anterior margin nearly straight (maximum diameter 0.55—0.60, minimum diameter 0.45—0.50 mm), shorter than the pronotum. Ocelli broadly oval (maximum diameter 0.20—0.28, minimum diameter 0.18—0.20 mm), touching the compound eyes. Antennae 18-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus trapezoidal, each side with 1 long and 1 short seta. Anteclypeus transparent, hairless, short, band-like. Labrum broadly dome-shaped, anterior margin and surface with a few long and short hairs. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat, subrectangular, wider posteriorly, wider than the head width including compound eyes; length about two-thirds of width (length 1.00—1.10, width 1.58—1.88 mm); margins and surface with long and short hairs. Legs long and hairy, tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented, with arolia. Wings pale brown, transparent, membrane without nodules. Fore wing 11.40—13.50 mm long: the subcosta joins the costa a short distance from the wing scale, the radius joins the subcosta—costa slightly beyond the middle of the wing, the radial sector has 5—6 branches reaching the anterior margin, the media gives off 5—6 branches to the radial sector in the apical half, the cubitus has 9—10 branches reaching the posterior margin. Hind wing 10.30—11.70 mm long: wing scale small; the radius joins the subcosta—costa behind the middle of the wing, the radial sector has 4—5 branches, the media arises from the radial sector at or slightly before the middle of the wing membrane and has 4—6 short branches running to the radial sector, the cubitus has 8—9 branches reaching the posterior margin. Abdomen slender.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to red-brown; labrum, postclypeus and antennae yellowish brown; mandibles dark red-brown, paler at the base; thorax, legs and abdomen pale yellowish brown. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 9.80—10.50 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, width slightly less than two-thirds of the length (length to mandible base 3.25—3.31, width 2.00—2.05 mm); sides nearly straight, posterior part rounded, anterior part sometimes constricted; Y suture present; frons inclined at about 45°, weakly striate. Compound eyes oval, unpigmented, about one long diameter from the antennae (length 0.23—0.25 mm). Ocelli unpigmented, small dots at the ends of the lateral arms of the Y suture. Antennae more than 13-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 shortest, gradually lengthening from segment 5. Postclypeus and frons not distinctly differentiated; anteclypeus transparent, short, band-like. Labrum wide, tongue-shaped, anterior margin rounded; surface with 1 pair of short hairs, anterior margin with several longer hairs. Mandibles short and thick, 1.78—1.80 mm long, tips weakly incurved; basal swelling of the outer margin inconspicuous. Left mandible with 5 marginal teeth: the first triangular with a longer posterior margin, the second short and blunt, the third shorter and separated from the second by an arcuate margin, the fourth and fifth also short; right mandible with 2 conspicuous marginal teeth in the middle. Postmentum long, club-shaped; club bilobed, the anterior lobe with straight sides, the posterior lobe with rounded sides, the two lobes equally wide; sides gradually narrowing into a waist behind the midpoint, the waist less than half the maximum width; length 2.25—2.30, maximum width 0.70—0.73, waist width 0.28—0.30 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, sides rounded, anterior margin weakly incurved, posterior margin nearly straight; surface and margins with a few long and short hairs. Legs short and stout, sparsely hairy; tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval, hairy; cerci 2-segmented, 0.15 mm long; styli single-segmented, 0.16 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head pale yellowish brown; antennae paler; thorax, legs and abdomen cream-yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.80—7.00 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 1.10—1.63, maximum width 1.15—1.68 mm). Compound eyes unpigmented, oval, small dots. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest; segments 4 and 5 subequal. Labrum broadly dome-shaped. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat, subrectangular, sides weakly rounded, anterior margin incurved, posterior margin nearly straight; length 0.48—0.93, maximum width 0.98—1.80 mm. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
